title: Write the Irish statement of terms of employment for an hourly-paid support agent
person: An HR generalist at an Irish customer-support firm who owes a new starter the day-five statement.
review: Statement for Conor Byrne, customer support agent in Limerick from 11/01/2027, permanent with six months' probation; EUR 16.20 an hour paid weekly by credit transfer, pay reference period one week; 7.8 hours a normal day and 39 a normal week, overtime at time and a quarter; 20 days' annual leave; statutory sick pay; no occupational pension; notice under the 1973 Act; no collective agreement, registered employment agreement or employment regulation order; the note on the average hourly rate; signed and dated for the employer within five days of the start.
revised_review: The rate becomes EUR 16.80 an hour; nothing else changes.

criteria.text: Every mechanical check in run.py passes for this stage.
The five-day core terms: both full names, the employer's address, 7.8 hours a normal day and 39 a normal week, the overtime terms and the pay reference period.
Every item of s. 3(1) is there or marked not applicable, with the note on the average hourly rate.
Dated within five days of 11 January 2027.
Six months, the limit s. 6D sets.
EUR 16.20 an hour, weekly, by credit transfer.
Signed and dated for the employer.
Leave, sick pay and notice may point to the Acts; the names, place, job, dates and hours are stated.
The rate is EUR 16.80 an hour and nothing else changed.
